note: BCPack tables; see formats/06a-bcpack-tables.md. Values from published third-party work, see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. Not game data.

rans_models.description: Static rANS models. eab = alphabet index (alphabet of eab+1 bits), q = model number. Segment 0 is symbol 0; segment k>=1 is symbols [2^(k-1), 2^k). For symbol s in a segment: freq = freq, cum = base + freq*(s - first_symbol), modulo 65536. Reserved zero: if cum == 0 use (freq - 1, cum 1). Probability scale 65536.
rans_models.self_check: For every model the symbols tile cumulative values 1..65535 without gaps or overlap (each symbol starts where the previous one ends, the last ends at 65536), every frequency is at least 1, and the frequencies sum to 65535 because cumulative value 0 is reserved. Checked for all 144 models when this file was written: 0 failures.

presets.description: 256 preset slots, [R0, G0, B0, R1, G1, B1] (5, 6, 5, 5, 6, 5 bits). null = never referenced, not fitted.

selector_codebook.description: Symbol -> four 2-bit BC1 codes of a 2x2 pixel group in order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
selector_codebook.uncertain_note: Rare mirror pairs on which two independent fits disagree.
